bio: This stylish contemporary restaurant showcases the flavours of Latin American, with a menu dedicated to Peruvian cuisine with Brazilian influences. The pleasingly accessible dishes are designed with sharing in mind. The very friendly, professional and attentive front-of-house team are happy to cater to guests' individual wishes. Tip: Do take the time to sip on a cocktail at the bar – a DJ adds to the fun vibe at the weekend. The restaurant is located within the upscale Conrad Hamburg hotel, which occupies part of the Levantehaus. Fun fact: GRETA OTO is named after the tropical butterfly (also known as the glasswing butterfly), whose lightness and vibrancy reflect the spirit of the concept here.
